subject: Tip: generate 2–3 outlines, keep the strongest
preview: Same topic, different angles — pick the one that writes itself.
body:
1) Drop your topic
2) Generate a research statement + outline
3) Generate a second angle
4) Keep the outline that feels easiest to write
[[VALUE]]Writers stall on the first outline they see. Comparing two takes two extra minutes and usually saves a bad thesis angle.
[[SUB]]Research Generator makes that comparison cheap — free to download.
P.S. Start drafting from the easiest section of the winning outline, not chapter 1.
